limitations: Exercise is simulated nation training; soldier counts and losses do not reserve or modify actual armies
An administrator can inspect/retry pending rewards; there is no safe write-off or reassignment protocol when the original recipient nation no longer exists
Exercise storage is a local file even when the nation authority uses SQL; one server process must own the exercise directory, not a shared multi-server exercise service
Terminal results use the fixed version-1 deterministic algorithm; later award/ranking changes need a state-schema migration
Exercise and nation history is permanent; snapshots are limited to 64 MiB and bounded archival/large-state latency remain pending
Nation receipt snapshots fail closed if a referenced capital world cannot be resolved; offline-world maintenance and schema evolution need explicit procedures
Postcommit events and district refresh are best effort, not durable notifications; a lost acknowledgement path need not repeat UI feedback
Strict receipt protocol does not convert old interrupted ordinary XP additions into durable grants
Existing legacy parallel WarExercise model/events are not the service protocol and were not redefined
The empty disabled DoctrineServiceBudgetSpendingTest is not counted as passing coverage
pending: Nation/city-state creation charge and refund still use ordinary player withdraw/deposit plus balance inference; require durable original-ID receipts and lifecycle recovery audit
